title: BAN-ABSA: An Aspect-Based Sentiment Analysis dataset for Bengali and it's baseline evaluation
reasoning: The paper introduces a new benchmark dataset for Aspect-Based Sentiment Analysis called BAN-ABSA. One of the four primary aspects for classification in this dataset is 'Religion'. The dataset contains 1,753 comments under this category, and the paper evaluates models' performance on classifying sentiment related to this aspect, making it directly related to benchmarking religion.
